title: dam done request
description: The flags dam done takes, one key per flag without its dashes, and oid for its argument. interactive, children and depends need force.

oid.description: An oid or prefix of 4 or more hex characters, or an array of them for several objects.

filter.description: Act on every object this saved filter lists; inside a project, only its tasks unless global.

preview.description: Answer the changes and write nothing.

expect.description: Refuse, changing nothing, unless the set holds exactly this many objects.

as_one.description: For a token: the changes wait as one set the owner takes or declines whole.

children.description: up, keep or into:<name>. Default: keep.

global.description: Pick the saved filter's objects from every task and leave out the done_children rule of the project the command runs in.

project.description: Pick the saved filter's objects from the project at this path, such as pns/hooks/, from any folder; the done_children rule of the folder's project is left out. Not with global.

meta.description: The request's details, as --meta KEY=VALUE passes them: harness, session, model, effort, version or any other key.
